card.name: Slight-amount words before comparisons
card.fires_on: Softening words like "little", "bit", "slightly" and "quite" that come right before a comparison such as "over", "more than", "less than", "fewer than", "wider than", or "earlier".

modes.label: A little/bit over a figure
modes.description: "a little" or "a bit" followed by "over", "more than" or "less than" a number or measure.
modes.example: It took a<< bit>> over 4 years to paint.

modes.label: Slightly before comparative
modes.description: "slightly" placed before "more" or "fewer" than a quantity.

modes.label: Degree word before adjective
modes.description: "little", "bit" or "quite" before a comparative adjective or adverb, such as wider, earlier or often.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward comparative words like more, faster, easier and deeper, and away from "almost" or "nearly".
card.plain: It spots a small-amount word such as "a little" or "slightly" that is about to be followed by a comparison.
